questions.query: I consent to participate in this demographic and background survey about my children
questions.text:
Research Study Consent - Child Demographics Survey

Study Title: Resource Allocation and Child Development Study

Purpose: We are conducting research to understand how parents make decisions about investing in their children's development. This survey will collect basic demographic information about you and your children.

What you will do: Answer questions about your background, education, income, and your children's ages and development priorities. This should take approximately 5-10 minutes.

Risks and Benefits: There are no known risks to participating in this survey. The information will help researchers understand family decision-making patterns.

Confidentiality: Your responses will be kept confidential and used only for research purposes. No personally identifying information will be shared.

Voluntary Participation: Your participation is completely voluntary. You may stop at any time without penalty.

Contact: If you have questions about this research, please contact the research team.

questions.query: What is your highest level of education?
What is your approximate monthly household income?
Please provide information about your children in this study:
How satisfied are you with each child's current school? (Scale: 1=Very dissatisfied, 5=Very satisfied)
Between {child1name} (ability: {child1ability}) and {child2name} (ability: {child2ability}), who do you think has more potential for academic success?
Approximately how many hours per week do you spend helping each child with schoolwork?
Which of the following are important priorities when investing in your children's education? (Select all that apply)
For each type of educational support, which child would benefit more?

questions.text: Thank you for providing information about {child1name} and {child2name}. This completes the demographic section of our study for participant {participant} working with enumerator {enumerator}.
